documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) Of The Company For The Second Quarter (Q2) And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong set of Q1 FY27 results with EBITDA margins crossing 20%, driven by operational efficiency and higher sales volume rather than inventory gains. The commercial production of the new laminate plant has faced minor delays due to weather and family issues, but dry run trials are ongoing and commercial operations are targeted for September 1, 2026. Domestic market restructuring is underway with a revamped team and expanded warehouse network, with visible revenue contributions expected from Q3 FY27 onwards. The recently acquired strategic partner Aica will primarily collaborate on technology transfer and potential product sourcing. Stylam Industries Limited reported a 15% year-on-year increase in revenue for Q1 FY27 and maintained its zero-debt status.

guidance.claim: The third plant is expected to generate around INR250 crores to INR300 crores in revenue.
guidance.quote: I think based on the value of what you were saying, around INR250 crores to INR300 crores, it would be easily achieved from the third plant.

guidance.claim: Sustainable EBITDA margins are expected to remain in the 19% to 20% plus range even after the new capex starts.
guidance.quote: So, we can expect the similar kind of margins 19%, 20% plus.

guidance.claim: Stylam expressed confidence in achieving its financial guidance, indicating sustained momentum for growth.
guidance.quote: Stylam is confident in achieving its financial guidance, indicating sustained momentum for growth.

guidance.claim: The company expects to generate between INR300 crores and INR400 crores in turnover from the new plant in the next three quarters.
guidance.quote: But we are quite hopeful that we can get INR300 crores, INR400 crores turnover from this plant in the next 3 quarters.

guidance.claim: Management targets INR250 crores to INR300 crores from the new plant for the current financial year and around 80 percent utilization next year.
guidance.quote: For this financial year, I think we will target INR250 crores to INR300 crores from that particular plant. And next year, we would be targeting around 80% utilization.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates a 20% to 25% increase in revenue for FY27 compared to the previous year, depending on market conditions.
guidance.quote: We cannot, it will be definitely 20%, 25% increase than the previous. Again, depends on the situation.

guidance.claim: Management expects the acrylic segment revenue to reach between INR50 crores and INR70 crores this year.
guidance.quote: I think this year, we would be doing INR50 crores to INR60 crores, INR50 crores to INR70 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Europe is performing well, and positive growth is also seen in the APAC region and Middle East.
demand_outlook.quote: And definitely Europe is our most Europe is doing good. Further ahead I think APAC region and Middle East. So, I think to be honest it's going positive for us in the export market.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted rapid advancement in expansion to meet increasing market demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The rapid advancement in expansion highlights Stylam's commitment to enhancing production capacity and meeting increasing market demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that price increases have not dampened demand as people continue constructing and buying.
demand_outlook.quote: It is not that if the prices go up, people will stop buying it and stop construction.

capex_expansion.claim: The new plant will commence commercial production by the first week of September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production would be 1st of September, first week of September.

capex_expansion.claim: Dry run trials for the new plant are currently ongoing.
capex_expansion.quote: Dry run, dry run trial is already going on.

capex_expansion.claim: Future major capex announcements will be delayed until the new plant is operational by the end of August or early September.
capex_expansion.quote: So that is why, once plant is operated by end August, early September, definitely we will announce about our new capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The groundwork for the new plant is underway to enhance the ability to meet rising global demand.
capex_expansion.quote: The groundwork for the new plant is underway, enhancing our ability to meet rising global demand with greater speed and scale.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is commissioning a new greenfield manufacturing facility as its third laminate plant located next to the existing facility at Manak Tabra.
capex_expansion.quote: Stylam Industries is strengthening its leadership position with commissioning of new green-field manufacturing facility, our third laminate plant, strategically located next to our existing facility at Manak Tabra in Panchkula, Haryana

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new expansion plant is progressing well.
capex_expansion.quote: The construction of the new expansion plant is progressing well.

capex_expansion.claim: The third greenfield laminate plant in Manak Tabra is expected to start commercial production between the end of June and the middle of July.
capex_expansion.quote: Hopefully it will be maximum middle of July, minimum end of June, it will start commercial production.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex incurred so far for the new plant is INR334 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have at this moment done the capex of INR334 crores.

margins_costs.claim: The margin expansion in the quarter was driven by operational efficiency and higher sales volumes rather than inventory gains.
margins_costs.quote: No, no inventory gain. nothing. It is our efficiency and it is our more utilization and if you go for sales figures it is increased. So, when sales increase, the expenses automatically reduce.

margins_costs.claim: Phenol prices are approximately USD1,400 per ton, and melamine prices are around USD1,000 to USD1,100.
margins_costs.quote: Right now, the phenol prices are approximately around USD1,400 per ton. Melamine is around USD1,000 to USD1,100.

margins_costs.claim: The company enhanced the share of value-added products in the product mix, expanded the product range, and improved net gross margins.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced the share of value-added products in the product mix, expanded the product range, and improved net gross margins.

margins_costs.claim: The new plant is expected to maintain a profit margin pattern of 22% to 24%.
margins_costs.quote: It would be on the same pattern.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin was reported at 49% in the fourth quarter.
margins_costs.quote: I think it was 49% in the fourth quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The company has increased prices by 3% to 5% for customers in response to rising raw material costs.
margins_costs.quote: We already increased 3% to 5% to our customers, almost every manufacturer.

orders_capacity.claim: Stylam operates an annual production capacity of approximately 20 million laminate sheets.
orders_capacity.quote: Annual production capacity of approximately 20 million laminate sheets.

orders_capacity.claim: Stylam sold 3.17 million sheets during Q1 FY27 compared to 3.27 million sheets in Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Company has sold 3.17 Mn Sheets during the Q1 FY27 (Domestic - 1.10 Mn & Export 2.07 Mn) as compared to 3.27 Mn Sheets in Q4 FY26 (Domestic - 1.06 Mn & Export 2.21 Mn).

orders_capacity.claim: The hot coating technology has a production capacity of 1 million laminates per year.
orders_capacity.quote: World’s latest Hot Coating technology with production capacity of 1 million laminates per year.

orders_capacity.claim: The 100% Acrylic Solid Surface production capacity stands at 300,000 panels per year.
orders_capacity.quote: 100% Acrylic Solid Surface production capacity of 300,000 panels per year.

orders_capacity.claim: The capacity utilization reached approximately 74% following modular expansions at existing facilities.
orders_capacity.quote: The company reached approximately 74% capacity utilization in the laminates division following modular expansions at existing facilities, increasing overall capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The laminate division achieved a 74% capacity utilization in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Okay. And one more, sir, on the capacity utilization, the laminate division achieved a 74% capacity utilization in FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: Stylam became a net debt-free company and maintained this status even after establishing a new plant.
capital_allocation.quote: Became a net debt-free company and maintained this status, even after establishing a new plant.

capital_allocation.claim: Stylam maintains its status as a zero-debt entity.
capital_allocation.quote: Stylam maintains its status as a zero-debt entity, reflecting strong financial health and effective capital management.

risks_headwinds.claim: Logistics is a significant problem globally, including for the Middle East.
risks_headwinds.quote: As of now, see, there are challenges in terms of logistics if we talk about right now for Middle East. In fact, for the entire world right now logistics is a very big problem, but that is a part of the business.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supreme Court observations and environment clearance requirements from the Ministry of Environment in Delhi caused a delay in the plant commissioning.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually, in last year, maybe October, November, there was some Supreme Court observation in this area -- clarification, we need to have to meet EC, environment clearance. So then we applied that environment clearance to MOF, Ministry of Environment Delhi, as there is no CER available in Haryana at that time.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material commodity prices have increased for companies due to supplies coming from the Middle East market.
risks_headwinds.quote: See, the things, the raw material commodity prices have increased for each and every company, not only laminates, we talk about any company, any product due to this, all the supply are coming from Middle East market.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production of the new plant will begin by September 1, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Commercial production would be 1st of September, first week of September.

management_commitments.claim: Domestic market restructuring results and significant volume ramp-up will be visible from Q3 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: And you will definitely see the results from Quarter 3. I won't even say Quarter 2, but you will see the results from Quarter 3 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: A new major capex will be announced once the current plant is operational by the end of August or early September.
management_commitments.quote: So that is why, once plant is operated by end August, early September, definitely we will announce about our new capex.

management_commitments.claim: Stylam is committed to enhancing production capacity and meeting increasing market demand.
management_commitments.quote: The rapid advancement in expansion highlights Stylam's commitment to enhancing production capacity and meeting increasing market demand.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production at the new Manak Tabra plant will commence between the end of June and the middle of July.
management_commitments.quote: Hopefully it will be maximum middle of July, minimum end of June, it will start commercial production.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets 80% plus capacity utilization of the new plant in the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And that is why what we were saying that the ramp-ups definitely in the next 2 years, we will be able to achieve 80% plus capacity utilization of the new plant.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve INR250 crores to INR300 crores from the new plant in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: For this financial year, I think we will target INR250 crores to INR300 crores from that particular plant.

management_commitments.claim: Brand visibility efforts in the domestic market are expected to yield results in the coming quarters.
management_commitments.quote: So hopefully, you'll see the results in the coming quarters.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
